title_en: DEBRIS — SPACE JUNK & THE KESSLER SYNDROME
title_ru: ОБЛОМКИ — КОСМИЧЕСКИЙ МУСОР И СИНДРОМ КЕССЛЕРА
description: An interactive field guide to orbital debris: why a centimetre-sized fragment at 11 km/s carries the energy to shatter a satellite, the 2007 Fengyun-1C test and the 2009 Iridium–Cosmos collision, how long debris stays up at each altitude, Kessler and Cour-Palais' warning of a self-sustaining debris belt, and the FCC's five-year deorbit rule.
og: A marble at 11 km/s, the first satellite-on-satellite crash, and debris that stays for centuries — orbital debris, interactive and sourced from NASA's Orbital Debris Program Office.
brand: DEBRIS — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
